_comment: Aetos concept id -> Mulberry Symbols file name (without .svg).
This file contains NO ARTWORK. Addendum A.63 permits bundling concept
identifiers and mappings; symbol imagery requires explicit licensing
review, so the images are fetched by scripts/build_symbol_pack.py and
Every entry was checked against Mulberry's own symbol-info-en.csv and
then against the repository itself. Nothing here was guessed.
COVERAGE IS PARTIAL AND THE GAPS MATTER. Mulberry is a vocabulary set
for adults, not a core communication board: its largest categories are
country flags, country maps and professions. It has no symbol for yes,
no, stop, please, thank you, sorry, friend, or the pronouns you/we/they.
Those concepts fall back to their text label, which is correct
behaviour (A.62 forbids substituting a near-miss) but leaves the most
urgent words as the only ones without a picture.
Whether that is usable, or whether the concept list should change to
match an available set, is a judgement for an AAC practitioner (A.94).
